profile.headline: Front-End Developer @ Impressive Dynamic Solutions | React, JavaScript, UI Development | Bilingual (EN/ES)
profile.summary: With a foundation in programming from Tidewater Community College and ongoing studies in Business Administration at Western Governors University, I currently contribute to Impressive Dynamic Solutions as a Front-End Developer and IT Specialist. In my roles, I focus on maintaining internal web pages, improving user interfaces, and providing essential IT support, from hardware maintenance to remote user assistance.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Maintained internal web pages with a strong focus on user interface layout and presentation using HTML and CSS.  
• Assisted in structural updates to enhance internal digital tools for improved team workflows.  
• Collaborated with team members to update formatting, styles, and documentation for web solutions.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
• Performed physical maintenance and component upgrades for organizational computers, enhancing system performance.  
• Managed the initial setup and software deployment for workstations, ensuring seamless operation for personnel.  
• Developed clear documentation for hardware setups and routine IT processes, improving team efficiency.

positions.title: Competent Person
positions.description:
Impressive Dynamic Solutions certified me as a Competent Person, in order to:
• Conduct thorough testing of workspace atmospheres to ensure safety for entry and hot work operations.  
• Collaborate with team members to assess adjacent spaces, enhancing overall safety protocols.  
• Maintain compliance with safety regulations, contributing to a secure working environment.

positions.title: Content Creator
positions.description:
• Developed and managed a gaming YouTube channel, growing it to over 21,000 subscribers.  
• Created, recorded, and edited engaging short-form and long-form videos using Adobe Creative Suite.  
• Analyzed YouTube Analytics to enhance content performance and audience engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: Content Creation · Adobe Photoshop · FL Studio · Video Editing · Adobe Premiere Pro · After Effects · Digital Media · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Barge Manager
positions.description:
• Managed maintenance operations on vessels, ensuring optimal performance and safety.  
• Utilized power and hand tools for repairs and installations, adhering to strict safety regulations.  
• Maintained facilities for Navy personnel, fostering a reliable and efficient working environment.  
• Collaborated with government overseers daily to ensure compliance and operational standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Shipfitting · Marine Chemist Certified Competent Person · Electrical Wiring · Pipefitting · Plumbing · Permit Authorizing Individual · OSHA 10-Hour · Shipyard Safety

positions.title: Laborer
positions.description:
• Conducted maintenance on ships and vessels, ensuring operational efficiency and safety.  
• Utilized various power and hand tools, adhering to safety regulations and standards.  
• Gained foundational knowledge in fiber optics while pulling and routing cables.  
• Engaged in painting tasks to maintain the aesthetic and functional quality of vessels.
positions.insights: Skills: Fire Safety · Cable Management · Painting · Fiber Optics · Maintenance and Repair

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Delivered exceptional customer service by building strong relationships with clients, ensuring a positive shopping experience.  
• Utilized POS systems and adhered to inventory protocols to maintain operational efficiency.  
• Collaborated with team members and worked independently to meet daily sales goals.  
• Resolved customer complaints and inquiries professionally, enhancing customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Receiver and Stocker
positions.description:
• Efficiently unloaded and stocked merchandise, ensuring an organized and orderly workspace.  
• Documented and accounted for all received items, maintaining accuracy in inventory management.  
• Identified and reported damaged or missing items to uphold quality standards.  
• Contributed to a clean and organized environment, enhancing overall operational efficiency.

positions.title: Receiver and Stocker
positions.description:
• Received and unpacked incoming shipments, ensuring all items were accounted for and in good condition.  
• Stocked shelves, racks, and bins efficiently to maintain an organized inventory.  
• Conducted regular cycle counts to ensure inventory accuracy and compliance with safety procedures.
